label: For "Public Safety Agent Action Guardrails": Bound what AI agents may do in dispatch, records and alerting systems for emergency services, keep a human decision on every consequential step and preserve a record that can stand up to review. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Direct dispatch rights.
